design_rationale:
WHY A GOOD TEST. A consumer member asks only to confirm the freight pickup of her loveseat. The confirmation is her own write (confirm_freight_pickup_4c90eb99, owner=user) and carries the member pickup fee - but that fee is not fixed until every changed-mind return the returns center has received on the purchase carries its restocking fee. The ottoman was received on 2026-10-01 with neither refund nor restocking fee booked; the restocking fee is a percentage of the refund, so the agent must post the changed-mind refund, then the settlement restocking fee, and only then quote and hand over the pickup fee. Three computations of 5, 5 and 6 factors read the collection's ledger, the delivery appointment and its charges, the card ledger and the membership.

SCOPE. Draw (draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems=2, factor_counts=[5, 6, 5]: the changed-mind refund takes 5, the settlement restocking fee 5 and the member pickup fee 6. Already occupied by task 0: order_ext_business_route_pickup_fee and order_ext_business_restocking_charge with their tools (business-segment confirmation-time charges). This task claims the remaining three consumer-side policies (order_ext_changed_mind_refund, order_ext_settlement_restocking_fee, order_ext_member_pickup_fee) and tools (post_changed_mind_refund_b29df74c, charge_restocking_fee_79f2f340, confirm_freight_pickup_4c90eb99); nothing is left unclaimed.

POLICIES. The changed-mind refund extends order_returns (overwrite of 'Each returned unit is refunded at order_msr_sale_unit_price, ...') with base_policy_refs [order_agg_return_review, order_cancellation, order_returns, order_returnless_refunds] - every base policy whose subject includes order_line_returned / order_partially_returned / order_fully_returned; trigger state_due (a received authorization without a refund is owed). The settlement restocking fee and the member pickup fee extend the order_returns fee sentence for consumer memberships (refs [order_returns, order_fees]); restocking is state_due once the refund stands, the pickup fee on_request at the member's confirmation. Inherited: Special Order 30-day override window, freight_pickup only, changed_mind not waived, refund to the purchase tender (northgate_visa), the membership-wide changed-mind review (2 refunds, 714.98 in 365 days, below 18 / 2,500.00).

FACTOR CARD - changed-mind refund (baseline 449.99; gold 418.12). collection_savings_rate (parameter, multi-source kept units AND class sales): 2 kept, 4,549.96 -> 6% (baseline gives 431.62); repeat_changed_mind_points (parameter): one earlier changed-mind refund on the purchase -> 1.5 (baseline 421.49); near-miss: the umbrella changed-mind refund on the In-Club purchase does not count, counting it gives 3 points; collection_inspection_period (method): day 7 -> half (baseline 401.24); crew_teardown_rate (parameter, cross-difficulty delivery): White Glove -> 30.00 (baseline 433.12); card_return_protection (method, multi-source tender AND card, cross-difficulty card): Visa tender + Visa Signature -> half (baseline 403.12).

FACTOR CARD - settlement restocking fee (baseline 15% x 418.12 = 62.72; gold 23.0). settlement_card_rate (parameter, multi-source card AND 12-month spend, cross-difficulty card): 5,640.20 -> 12.5% (baseline 28.22); near-miss: the 2025-09 statement (1,880.00) is 12 whole months back today, though it was inside the window on 2026-09-25 when the table's fee used 10% - copying the table's rate is the trap; settlement_tenure_points (parameter, cross-difficulty membership): 102 months -> 2 off (baseline 27.18); settlement_piece_value_points (parameter): 449.99 -> +1 (baseline 20.91); settlement_kept_order_points (parameter): 2 of 4 kept after the refund -> 0.5 off (baseline 24.04); settlement_timing (method): day 7 -> 0.5 (baseline 45.99).

FACTOR CARD - member pickup fee (baseline 79.00; gold 72.8). member_pickup_distance (27 miles -> +15; baseline 60.8), member_pickup_stairs (one flight -> +10; baseline 64.8), member_pickup_crew (1199.99 -> +15; baseline 60.8), member_pickup_followup_credit (two earlier pickup fees -> -20; baseline 88.8), member_pickup_cardholder_credit (Visa Signature -> -8; baseline 79.2), member_pickup_loyalty_rate (method, multi-source tier AND months, cross-difficulty membership: Club, 102 months -> 0.8; baseline 91.0). Every tier rests on records; no stamp is read.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root order_ext_member_pickup_fee (user). Edge 1 -> order_ext_settlement_restocking_fee: state_gate, gate order_lines.fee_type, form state, sentence 'The member pickup fee on a special order is not fixed until every changed-mind return on that purchase whose merchandise the returns center has logged as received carries its restocking fee entry.' (negated direction: the desk states what the pickup booking waits for). Edge 2 settlement restocking fee -> order_ext_changed_mind_refund: value_input, gate refund_posted, form state, sentence 'The settlement restocking fee is fixed only after the changed-mind refund for the units the returns center has logged as received stands on the purchase.' (affirmative: a charge is fixed only after what it rests on). Four-point tests: ordering connectives 'not ... until' / 'only after'; record-visible states (a restocking_fee entry per received authorization's sale line; a changed_mind order_line_returned entry on the received line); no tool, id or code token; scope exactly 'every received changed-mind return on the purchase' / 'the units logged as received'. Uniqueness of the resolving write: on a consumer purchase only the settlement restocking fee books restocking_fee entries (the business restocking charge is scoped to business memberships), and only the changed-mind refund books changed_mind refunds of received units. False at frozen_time: ottoman authorization received, no refund and no restocking entry on its line (the table line has both). Order: order_ext_changed_mind_refund -> order_ext_settlement_restocking_fee -> order_ext_member_pickup_fee. Deletion sensitivity: skipping the refund makes the restocking fee 0.00 (from 23.0); skipping the restocking fee drops its entry from the terminal state. user_scenario names neither prerequisite; tools validate nothing.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD (refund write). changed_mind_review_threshold: membership-wide changed-mind refunds in 365 days = umbrella 129.99 (2026-06-20) + table 584.99 (2026-09-25) = 2 refunds, 714.98 -> below 18 and 2,500.00. return_status: purchase partially_returned (allowed). return_window: Special Order override 30 days, fulfillment 2026-09-12 day 0, ottoman request 2026-09-19 = day 7 (inclusive bound day 30 = 2026-10-12). authorization_received: ottoman authorization status received. no_double_refund: no refund entry on the ottoman line. order_returnless_refunds gates (report_window, returnless_claim_limit) govern damage/missing/not-received reports; this refund carries none, so they impose nothing (recorded satisfied). order_cancellation: policy scope only (purchase not cancelled). Fee writes: no gate of order_returns/order_fees applies to order_fee_charged -> policy_scope.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Refund and restocking: ottoman authorization 337457d7-d238-4ac7-9781-61d912534dce -> sale line f1e9ccac-7925-4e01-8f7b-5c59861faf46 (1 x 449.99). Included in aggregates: the four Special Order sale lines (class sales, units), the table refund (repeat count, units refunded), the two pickup fee entries (follow-up credit). Excluded: the In-Club purchase's lines (other purchase) except in the membership-wide review. The table's refund and restocking settle only the table line. Pickup: loveseat authorization 346fe613-6582-4065-b51b-db36993d2d55 -> sale line bf590196-a05e-49f5-9f87-627e5dc3702b.

SEED. Two purchases (Special Order collection with its full return history; an In-Club purchase with a changed-mind counter return), three authorizations (two received, one submitted), White Glove delivery with base and one stair_carry charge, Club membership, an active Visa Signature with 26 statement earnings (2% Northgate / 1% other). Historical fee and refund rows equal what the extended policies gave on their own dates (pickup 83.20 and 68.80; table refund 584.99; table restocking 23.40 at 10% while the 2025-09 statement was still in the window). Every line is reward_eligible false, so no write triggers a membership reward reversal. No automatic clause fires.

PERSONA. Friendly, slightly apologetic, over-explains; volunteers only the goal (confirm the loveseat pickup set up Saturday) and the situation; phone, then date of birth; email/ZIP as alternatives; no order number; reason and tender on request; mentions the earlier pieces only if asked; passive consent to 'something else settled first'; runs the hand-over; asks for a re-check only on inconsistency; ends when told the pickup is confirmed.

STANDARD SOLUTION. Locate, verify (phone + DOB), read purchases, authorizations, lines, membership, delivery appointment and charges, card and its ledger. Post the ottoman refund 418.12 (partially_returned), charge the settlement restocking fee 23.0, quote the pickup fee 72.8, unlock and hand over the confirmation. Easy mistakes: quoting the pickup fee straight away (leaves the ottoman unsettled), copying the table's 10% rate, counting the umbrella refund as a repeat, refunding the full 449.99, using the full-sum pickup fee 91.00.

VERIFICATION. _author/t1_world.py evaluates each policy with check_compute's build_env on the handling-time world: refund 418.12 (factor baselines [['collection_savings_rate', 431.62], ['repeat_changed_mind_points', 421.49], ['collection_inspection_period', 401.24], ['crew_teardown_rate', 433.12], ['card_return_protection', 403.12]], all-baseline 449.99); restocking 23.0 ([['settlement_card_rate', 28.22], ['settlement_tenure_points', 27.18], ['settlement_piece_value_points', 20.91], ['settlement_kept_order_points', 24.04], ['settlement_timing', 45.99]], all-baseline 62.72); pickup 72.8 ([['member_pickup_distance', 60.8], ['member_pickup_stairs', 64.8], ['member_pickup_crew', 60.8], ['member_pickup_followup_credit', 88.8], ['member_pickup_cardholder_credit', 79.2], ['member_pickup_loyalty_rate', 91.0]], all-baseline 79.0); skipping the refund -> restocking 0.0; skipping the restocking -> pickup still 72.8 (state_gate). Gate runs in worklog.md.

DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. With compute/expected masked, the pickup prose's sentence sends the reader to the received ottoman (no restocking entry), the restocking prose's sentence to its missing refund; the refund prose with the records gives 418.12, the restocking prose 23.00, the pickup prose 72.80 - agreeing with gold.
user_scenario:
You are Corinne Vasquez-Holloway from Westerville, Ohio. In August you special-ordered the Harbor Bay living-room collection from Northgate - a sectional, a loveseat, a storage ottoman and a cocktail table - and the White Glove crew set it all up on September 12. The room never worked with that much furniture. On Saturday, October 3, you called and a representative set up a pickup for the loveseat; you were told it would only be scheduled once you confirmed it yourself, and you wanted to sleep on it. You have decided the loveseat goes, and you are calling to confirm that loveseat pickup today. You are friendly, a little apologetic, and you tend to explain more than you need to.
When asked how to find your account, you give your phone number, 6145550268. To verify, you give your date of birth, 1984-11-03; if they want a different detail, your email is corinne.vasquezholloway@lakeviewmail.com and your ZIP code is 43082. You do not have the order number handy - it is the Harbor Bay special order from August - and you ask them to look it up. If they ask why the loveseat is going back, you simply changed your mind; nothing is wrong with it. If they ask how you paid, it was your Northgate Visa. Only if they ask about the other pieces: the sectional stays, and you already sent back the cocktail table and the ottoman, which the crew collected a while ago.
You do not know what the pickup will cost and you never name a figure; you understand there is a charge for picking up special-order furniture. If the representative tells you something else on your order has to be settled first, you say that is fine and let them do it; if they mention money going back to your card, you are pleased but do not ask for details. When the representative tells you the pickup fee and hands the confirmation over to you, you complete it yourself with exactly the details they give you and read back what it shows if asked. If a figure sounds inconsistent with something they said earlier, you ask them to check it against the order, without proposing a number. You do not ask about anything else. Once they tell you the loveseat pickup is confirmed, you thank them warmly and say goodbye.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: A chain, no parallel prerequisites: the refund must precede the restocking fee (the fee is a percentage of it: 0.00 without it, 23.0 with it), and the restocking fee must stand before the pickup fee is fixed. The pickup fee's own figure (72.8) does not read the refund or the restocking entry, so no other order is defined by the policies.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the restocking fee leaves the ottoman's settlement restocking fee unbooked: the terminal state lacks the restocking_fee entry of 23.0 and the purchase's net paid ends 23.0 lower; the root's gate is then unmet when the pickup fee is booked.
Skipping the refund makes refund_posted 0.00, so the settlement restocking fee computes to 0.00 instead of 23.0, and the terminal state lacks the 418.12 refund entry and keeps net paid 418.12 higher.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario raises only the loveseat pickup confirmation. It never mentions the ottoman's refund, a restocking fee, or anything pending; the other pieces are described only if the representative asks, as already sent back. Reactions to 'something else has to be settled first' and to money going back to her card are passive. Neither prerequisite policy id occurs in it.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: post_changed_mind_refund_b29df74c, charge_restocking_fee_79f2f340 and confirm_freight_pickup_4c90eb99 each write unconditionally: none reads authorization status, existing refunds or restocking entries before booking, none returns an error, and the pickup confirmation succeeds whether or not the ottoman has its refund and restocking fee.
